name: vg-brain-windows
description: VG Brain (Windows x64, zero-install): connects with no system Node via a bundled, self-contained mcp-remote .exe (Bun --compile). UNTESTED in a real Cowork install on Windows pending the Mark-of-the-Web / SmartScreen check — do not treat as verified. Windows-arm64 is not covered (falls back to the npx plugin). Same OAuth/RBAC/capture as the cross-platform plugin.
